items.q: What is a web automation agent?
items.a: A web automation agent is software that carries out web workflows from instructions, such as logging in, filling forms or exporting data, without hand-written scripts.

items.q: How is Kane CLI different from other browser agents?
items.a: Kane CLI returns a verified pass or fail for each step and an evidence file, instead of a prose summary of what it believes it did.

items.q: Can AI coding agents use it?
items.a: Yes. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI can call Kane CLI and read the verdict.

items.q: Does it call a model on every run?
items.a: No. Unchanged steps replay from cache with no LLM cost. If the page changed, the broken step re-authors.
Kane CLI is free to install with npm. Runs use KaneAI credits; you can claim 10,000 free Kane CLI credits, valid for 30 days.
